message:
**A production deploy workflow failed** (`Fly Deploy`, or `Heroku Release` — the www.hihelloreid.com reporter, RC1-354). The service may be running the previous image/slug, or mid-rollout.

Check, in order:
1. The failing job on the [CI Visibility pipeline list](https://app.datadoghq.com/ci/pipelines) — build vs. release stage tells you whether anything shipped.
2. Fly apps: `fly status` / `fly logs`. Portfolio: `heroku releases -a hihelloreid` — a failed `Heroku Release` run means the site is still on the previous slug (release failed) or the DORA event went unrecorded (POST failed; the run log says which).
3. The [Site Observability dashboard](https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/aa2-k8g-ya8) for availability fallout.

**Why this monitor exists:** RC1-322 — the #39 boot crash-loop shipped silently because the deploy workflow doesn't gate on boot health. This catches the failed-deploy half of that class. The deploy-succeeded-but-boot-failed half still needs the health gate in the workflow itself; this monitor is not a substitute for it.
